subject: Bookend: coordinate demo timeline + onboard security & procurement

Subject: Bookend: coordinate demo timeline + onboard security & procurement

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and three asks so we can lock the next step: a demo + technical deep-dive.

Call recap (2 mins):
- Primary goal: validate Redwood can serve Finlytics’ inference patterns (low-3xx ms p50 at 1–2k qps, audit logs)
- Main constraints: vendor security questionnaire, procurement timeline (Q2 approval window), and SSO/SAML setup for pilot

Three asks:
1) Can you pick a preferred slot from these options?
   - Tue Apr 4: 09:00–10:00 PT (preferred for our infra leads)
   - Wed Apr 5: 13:00–14:00 PT
   - Thu Apr 6: 16:00–17:00 PT
2) Please confirm who from security and procurement should join (we recommend CISO/infosec + procurement lead).
3) Share any gating docs you want us to prep (SOC2 reports, network topology questions).

Attached: discovery-notes.pdf (call notes + initial checklist). I’ll loop in our platform/security reps once you confirm attendees.

If it helps, I can send a calendar poll; otherwise I’ll hold Tue Apr 4 as a provisional slot until EOD Wed.

Thanks — Jordan
